verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ElevenLabs Agents can be managed through the ElevenLabs API, and the quickstart walks through creating an agent via the API. Programmatic control is also offered through the Agents CLI and a hosted MCP server. missing for 10: API reference detail (endpoint coverage, authentication, SDKs) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of API-driven management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: ElevenLabs Agents are managed either through the ElevenAgents dashboard, the ElevenLabs API, the Agents CLI or the hosted MCP server.
we'll start by creating an agent via the API or the web dashboard
